newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Nedlloyd sees modest profit in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Nedlloyd sees modest profit in 1996.

text.p: Dutch shipping and road transport group Koninklijke Nedlloyd Groep NV said on Wednesday it expected a modest net profit for the whole of 1996.

"Taking into account that the fourth quarter is generally weak for Nedlloyd, we expect for Nedlloyd as a whole to end the year with a modestly positive result on ordinary activities after taxation," it said.

"We expected for 1996 an extraordinary income of approximately 100 million guilders..... We have decided to reserve this income now to the amount of 100 million guilders to cover our share in the provision for reorganisation costs P&O Nedloyd Container Line will make in 1997 as was announced previously," it said.
"The net result will be modestly positive," it said.
